verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a real-time live view URL for watching or taking over a running session. That is live observation, not a recorded replay. Nothing in the pack shows post-run video recordings, stored screenshots or step-by-step action timelines for debugging a failed run.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can debug a failed agent run from recorded replays — video, screenshots, step-by-step action timelines

citations.quote: Every session comes with a live view URL where you can watch your agent browse in real-time.
